title: Wake-Light Alarms
description: Home Assistant gradually brightens the room lights so they reach full brightness at the chosen wake time.

schedule.empty: No wake alarms yet. Add one with a time, days or date, and ramp settings.
schedule.adminOnly: Only Home Assistant administrators can edit wake alarms.

editor.daysRequired: A recurring alarm requires at least one weekday.
editor.futureDateRequired: A one-time alarm requires a future date.
editor.nameRequired: Wake alarm name is required. Enter a name.
editor.timeInvalid: Wake time is invalid. Choose a valid time.
editor.rampRequired: Choose a supported light ramp duration before saving.
editor.addToBedUpdateHint: Update the Wake Light integration to add temporary bed alarms for one-time wake alarms.

settings.description: The selected room default sets how long lights brighten before a new alarm, including no gradual ramp.
settings.holdDescription: After full brightness, Wake Light prevents ordinary presence lighting from changing the room for {{duration}}. Any manual or Siri light command ends the hold immediately.
settings.holdUpdateHint: Update the Wake Light integration to change post-wake hold time.

binding.label: Use Room Wake Lights
binding.alarmToggle: Use room wake lights for the {{alarm}} alarm

errors.unavailable: Wake-light controls are unavailable. Check Home Assistant, then try again.
errors.commandFailed: The wake light change was rejected. Review the settings, then try again.

feedback.conflict: Alarm configuration changed elsewhere. Review the latest settings before retrying.
feedback.episodeLimit: Connected alarms exceed 105 minutes. Reduce their ramps or separate their execution windows.
feedback.inactive: That wake episode ended or changed. Review the active episode before retrying.
feedback.transport: Home Assistant did not confirm the change. Check the connection before retrying.

blockers.source: The linked alarm schedule or scheduled wake is unavailable, so the wake light cannot start. Check the device connection and integration compatibility.
blockers.presence: Presence lighting is not ready to hand control to the wake light, so the wake cannot start safely. Check presence lighting before trying again.
blockers.blocker: Another lighting controller is active or its status is unknown, so the wake cannot start. Ensure the wake light has exclusive control, then try again.
blockers.legacy: The room's older lighting behavior is not confirmed compatible with wake-light control, so the wake light cannot start. Complete setup before trying again.
blockers.target: A required room light is unavailable, so the wake light cannot start. Check the light's connection, then try again.

behavior.activeStop: Stop ends the connected wake-light episode. Manual or Siri light commands take control immediately.
behavior.dropout: A safety or ownership interruption ends the active light episode. Control will not be reclaimed automatically, and the episode will not retry.
behavior.protocol: Editing wake light alarms requires an integration update. Saved alarms remain available to view.
